purpose: Proper leave-family-out refit screen after rejecting coefficient-zero ablation as invalid for full one-hot categorical blocks and uncentered arsenal features.

method.solver_note: Converged L2 multinomial refit used as a computational screen; governed saga confirmation is required before model change.

delta_definition: drop-family metric minus full-model metric; positive means family helps

screen_decisions.platoon: ADVANCE_TO_GOVERNED_SAGA_REMOVAL_TEST; removal improves both 2025 and 2026 holdouts
screen_decisions.arsenal: RETAIN_PENDING_GOVERNED_TEST; direction flips and 2026 shows positive value
screen_decisions.home_team_fit_only_nuisance: ADVANCE_TO_GOVERNED_STABILITY_TEST; direction flips and it is not a live inference feature

invalidated_method: Do not use coefficient-zero family ablation as variable importance for this model. Full one-hot blocks and uncentered numeric interactions make zeroing coefficients change the fitted level/intercept.
next_phase: 25D governed saga refits for platoon removal, arsenal stability, and home-team nuisance stability; then full-I2 replay only for challengers that survive.
